answer: Force each identity to take stances and stand by them. Every epoch, agents are paired into debates on randomly assigned theses, each arguing a fixed side; positions are committed on-ledger as ferrous-hard records nobody can quietly revise. A sybil farm finds no haven here: one operator cannot keep hundreds of puppets arguing opposing sides with original, internally consistent positions across epochs — the same hand betrays the lagoon of voices it steers, and graders score recycled stances zero. Sustained conviction is the one thing a copy cannot fake.
